text: APPROVE: `AppendStar` reproduces the original `*`, `**/` and trailing `**` branches with the same output and the same returned index (`i`, `i+2`, `i+1`), so behaviour is unchanged. Moving the nested ifs out drops `ToRegex` well below 15, and the new private static helper uses the already fully qualified `System.Text.StringBuilder`, so I see nothing that would add a warning. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build the project.
